name: Japan Trip — Studio Northstar Service Agreement.gdoc
content:
STUDIO NORTHSTAR TRAVEL — SERVICE AGREEMENT

Client: Maya Reeves
Travellers: Maya Reeves, Jamie Lopez (party of 2)
Destination: Japan — Tokyo (6 nights) and Kyoto (3 nights)
Trip dates: 11–22 April 2026

ITEMIZED PACKAGE
- Return flights LHR–HND–LHR (economy, 2 travellers): EUR 985.00
- Agency service fee: EUR 120.00
- Tokyo Riverside Hotel, 6 nights (11–17 April): JPY 168,000
- Kyoto Ryokan Sakura, 3 nights (17–20 April): JPY 96,000
- 7-day Japan Rail Pass (Green, 2 travellers): JPY 50,000
- Two guided day tours (Tokyo + Kyoto): JPY 38,000

Total package value approximately EUR 3,150, payable in two instalments (deposit + balance).
Instalment 1 (deposit): flights EUR 985.00 + service fee EUR 120.00, charged on booking.
Instalment 2 (balance): JPY accommodation, rail pass and tours, charged before departure.

Discretionary spending (meals, activities, shopping) is not included in this package and is settled directly by the client.

This agreement is between Maya Reeves and Studio Northstar Travel. Booking reference NRT8841.

name: Japan Itinerary — April 2026.gdoc
content:
JAPAN ITINERARY — APRIL 2026
Maya Reeves & Jamie Lopez

Day 1 — Sat 11 April (Tokyo): Fly LHR→HND. Check in to Tokyo Riverside Hotel (reservation R-55120). Evening: settle in, ramen near the hotel.
Day 2 — Sun 12 April (Tokyo): teamLab Planets Tokyo, afternoon entry (tickets x2). Explore Toyosu.
Day 3 — Mon 13 April (Tokyo): Daytime sightseeing. Evening: omakase dinner at Sushi Aoyama, Ginza (party of 2).
Day 4 — Tue 14 April (Tokyo): Shopping in Ginza — Uniqlo. Dinner: Tokyo Bay Ramen.
Day 5 — Wed 15 April (Tokyo): Guided Tokyo day tour. Convenience-store and metro day.
Day 6 — Thu 16 April (Tokyo): Free day, last morning in Tokyo.
Day 7 — Fri 17 April (Tokyo→Kyoto): Train Tokyo→Kyoto on the JR Pass. Check in to Kyoto Ryokan Sakura. Evening: kaiseki dinner at Hanami Tei (party of 2).
Day 8 — Sat 18 April (Kyoto): Guided Kyoto day tour. Temples and gardens.
Day 9 — Sun 19 April (Kyoto): Free day. Souvenir shopping at Don Quijote.
Day 10 — Mon 20 April (Kyoto): Check out of the ryokan, transfer back toward Tokyo area.
Day 11 — Tue 21 April: Buffer day.
Day 12 — Wed 22 April: Fly HND→LHR home.
